import collections, datetime, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, re, subprocess, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SOURCE = '8f76ba4bce7de100cd56274ca938c4da24b500dc'
CORE = 'docs/codex/evidence/T30-reports/'
EXPECTED_MANIFEST = 'e9b9d18aa8462b8acc04ab2a78d2fcc011ad82802f2ab239c40463e9526aa3f7'
issues, observations = [], {}
checks = 0

def check(ok, label, detail=None):
    global checks
    checks += 1
    if not ok:
        issues.append({'check': label, 'detail': detail})

def git(*args):
    p = subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True)
    check(p.returncode == 0, 'git command exit', list(args))
    return p.stdout

def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def load(path): return json.loads((ROOT/path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def old(path): return json.loads(git('show', 'HEAD:'+path))

head = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
check(head == SOURCE, 'base HEAD is accepted C1b', head)
check(git('branch', '--show-current').decode().strip() == 'codex/v1.0.0-readiness', 'branch')
check(git('remote', 'get-url', 'origin').decode().strip() == 'https://github.com/PikkuJanne/WinPDFMerger.git', 'origin')
check(not git('diff', '--name-only'), 'no unstaged tracked edits')
check(not git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard'), 'no unintended untracked files')
check(not git('diff', '--cached', '--check'), 'cached whitespace check')
staged = [p.decode() for p in git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only', '-z').split(b'\0') if p]
check(len(staged) == 1001, 'intended staged path count', len(staged))
check(all(p.startswith('docs/codex/') for p in staged), 'records-only staged paths')
index = {}
for entry in git('ls-files', '--stage', '-z').split(b'\0'):
    if not entry: continue
    meta, path = entry.split(b'\t', 1)
    mode, oid, stage = meta.decode().split()
    index[path.decode()] = (mode, oid, stage)
diff = git('diff', '--cached', '--binary')
observations['staged_diff_sha256'] = sha(diff)
observations['staged_paths'] = staged

manifest_data = (ROOT/(CORE+'manifest.json')).read_bytes()
manifest = json.loads(manifest_data)
check(sha(manifest_data) == EXPECTED_MANIFEST, 'accepted manifest exact hash')
check(manifest['source_commit'] == SOURCE, 'manifest source')
check(manifest['payload_count'] == len(manifest['files']) == 987, 'manifest count')
check(sum(f['bytes'] for f in manifest['files']) == 34624295, 'manifest bytes')
paths = {f['path'] for f in manifest['files']}
check(len(paths) == 987, 'manifest unique paths')
post = {'review/public-review.py', 'review/public-review.json'}
expected_inventory = paths | post | {'manifest.json'}
actual_inventory = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT/CORE)).replace('\\', '/') for p in (ROOT/CORE).rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
check(actual_inventory == expected_inventory, 'exact public core inventory', sorted(actual_inventory ^ expected_inventory))
check(set(manifest['post_manifest_review_files']) == post, 'only accepted post-manifest files')
for f in manifest['files']:
    rel = CORE+f['path']
    check(not pathlib.PurePosixPath(f['path']).is_absolute() and '..' not in pathlib.PurePosixPath(f['path']).parts, 'manifest path containment', rel)
    data = (ROOT/rel).read_bytes()
    check(len(data) == f['bytes'] and sha(data) == f['sha256'], 'public payload bytes/hash', rel)
for p in expected_inventory:
    rel = CORE+p
    data = (ROOT/rel).read_bytes()
    mode, oid, stage = index.get(rel, ('', '', ''))
    raw_oid = hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()
    check(mode == '100644' and stage == '0', 'public regular index blob', rel)
    check(raw_oid == oid, 'index equals accepted working payload bytes', rel)

xml_files = [p for p in paths if p.lower().endswith('.xml')]
leaf_counts = collections.Counter()
for p in xml_files:
    try:
        root = ET.fromstring((ROOT/(CORE+p)).read_bytes())
        for c in root.iter('test-case'): leaf_counts[c.attrib.get('result', 'missing')] += 1
    except Exception as e: check(False, 'projected XML parses', {'path':p, 'error':str(e)})
check(len(xml_files) == 191, 'XML inventory', len(xml_files))
observations['xml_inventory'] = {'files':len(xml_files), 'historical_and_final_leaf_results':dict(leaf_counts)}
check(not any(pathlib.PurePosixPath(p).suffix.lower() in {'.pdf','.png','.zip','.exe','.dll','.pfx','.pem','.key'} for p in actual_inventory), 'no excluded binary/private payloads')
pub = load(CORE+'review/public-review.json')
check(pub['result'] == 'pass' and not pub['issues'] and pub['checks'] == 782463, 'independent public audit acceptance')
check(pub['source_commit'] == SOURCE and pub['manifest_sha256'] == EXPECTED_MANIFEST and pub['manifest_payloads'] == 987 and pub['public_bytes'] == 34624295, 'public audit binding')
check(sha((ROOT/(CORE+'review/public-review.py')).read_bytes()) == pub['auditor_sha256'], 'public auditor exact bytes')

frozen = {'source-review.md':'67448ea3fe0299022a7aaec79e478a326f00bc5774f4c510017c0f6a8a837770', 'source-review.json':'96438c856c88d273a18b86ae03cdbc39343db8b12088b0ae3deee90e7b0e3efa', 'final-C1b-original-audit.json':'d313860a170405bf62c551151bdc0f69c2a29c28133ef1632b94973a72a7f090', 'final-C1b-native-original-audit.json':'9781dc2da536edcf6a5f679061847c65e925e497ac84dbeb5beb2e4e7b7779d3', 'final-C1b-ci-original-audit.json':'9717ca2c51ac7c5bda249616b738c1c695ec0af5e32980390a6bb0955f59d560'}
for p, digest in frozen.items(): check(sha((ROOT/'tests/.work/T30-review'/p).read_bytes()) == digest, 'frozen original independent review unchanged', p)

task_path, case_path = 'docs/codex/TASKS.json', 'docs/codex/ACCEPTANCE_CASES.json'
tasks, oldtasks = load(task_path), old(task_path)
cases, oldcases = load(case_path), old(case_path)
tmap, amap = {t['id']:t for t in tasks['tasks']}, {c['id']:c for c in cases['cases']}
check(len(tasks['tasks']) == 34 and sum(t['status']=='done' for t in tasks['tasks']) == 30, 'task counts')
check(tmap['T30']['status']=='done' and all(tmap['T'+str(n)]['status']=='pending' for n in range(31,35)), 'task handoff')
for t in oldtasks['tasks']:
    if t['id'] != 'T30': check(t == tmap[t['id']], 'other task unchanged', t['id'])
case_counts = dict(collections.Counter(c['result'] for c in cases['cases']))
check(len(cases['cases'])==78 and case_counts=={'pass':66,'excluded':4,'not_run':8}, 'case counts', case_counts)
check(amap['AC058']['result']=='excluded' and not amap['AC058']['required'], 'owner AC058 exclusion unchanged')
check(all(amap['AC'+str(n).zfill(3)]['result']=='not_run' for n in range(71,79)), 'remaining release cases not_run')
for c in oldcases['cases']:
    if c['id'] not in {'AC069','AC070'}: check(c == amap[c['id']], 'other case unchanged', c['id'])
check(all(amap[c]['result']=='pass' for c in ['AC069','AC070']), 'T30 cases pass')
release_path='docs/codex/RELEASE_STATE.json'
release, oldrelease=load(release_path),old(release_path)
for k,v in oldrelease.items():
    if k!='readiness_evidence': check(release.get(k)==v, 'release state unchanged', k)
check(release['state']=='not_started', 'no release acceptance')

r=load('docs/codex/evidence/T30-results.json')
check(r['result']=='pass' and r['tested_source_commit']==SOURCE, 'results exact source binding')
check(r['local_full_passed']==2144 and r['local_full_tiers_per_host']==32 and r['local_full_report_pairs']==64, 'full counts')
for shell in ['ps51','ps7']:
    a=r['hosts'][shell]['aggregate']
    check(a['passed']==1072 and a['tiers']==32 and a['bad_counts']==0 and a['commit_under_test']==SOURCE and a['dirty_worktree'] is False, 'actual clean full per-host',shell)
    check(sum(r['hosts'][shell]['tier_counts'].values())==1072, 'tier sum',shell)
check(r['supplementary_helpers']['total_passed']==83 and r['supplementary_helpers']['total_skipped']==1 and r['supplementary_helpers']['is_native_or_manual_acceptance'] is False, 'helper skip/class counts')
u=r['unaccepted_preparation']
check(u['aborted_clean_C1']['passed_per_host']==822 and u['aborted_clean_C1']['failed_per_host']==1 and u['aborted_clean_C1']['is_accepted'] is False and u['dirty_affected_fix_checks']['passed_per_host']==33, 'failed history and dirty preparation scopes')
check(u['public_export']['invalid_projected_xml_files']==111 and u['public_export']['second_privacy_violations']==111 and not u['public_export']['original_receipts_changed'], 'projected failures disclosed')
check(r['public_evidence']['manifest_sha256']==EXPECTED_MANIFEST and r['public_evidence']['payload_count']==987 and r['public_evidence']['payload_bytes']==34624295, 'results public manifest binding')
for p, v in r['independent_reviews'].items():
    data=(ROOT/(CORE+p)).read_bytes(); report=json.loads(data)
    check(sha(data)==v['sha256'] and str(report['result']).startswith('pass') and v['result']==report['result'], 'review accepted hash/result',p)
check('commands' not in r and bool(r['command_templates']) and all((ROOT/p).is_file() for p in r['exact_executed_argv_receipts']), 'templates distinguished from actual argv receipts')

for path in ['docs/codex/evidence/T30-ready-plan.json','docs/codex/evidence/T30-PR-review.json']:
    receipt=load(path)
    check(receipt['exit_code']==0, 'record receipt exit',path)
    check(sha(receipt['stdout_utf8'].encode())==receipt['raw_stdout_sha256'] and sha(receipt['stderr_utf8'].encode())==receipt['raw_stderr_sha256'], 'record receipt stream hashes',path)
    check(json.loads(receipt['stdout_utf8'])==receipt['parsed'], 'record receipt typed stdout',path)
ready=load('docs/codex/evidence/T30-ready-plan.json')
check(ready['base_HEAD']==SOURCE and ready['dirty_records'] is True and ready['parsed']['valid'] is True and ready['parsed']['done_tasks']==30 and ready['parsed']['passed_cases']==66 and ready['parsed']['excluded_cases']==4, 'ready record scope/counts')
pr=load('docs/codex/evidence/T30-PR-review.json')['parsed']
check(pr['headRefOid']==SOURCE and pr['baseRefName']=='main' and pr['isDraft'] is True and pr['state']=='OPEN' and pr['reviewDecision']=='', 'PR source/state/no invented platform approval')
check(len(pr['statusCheckRollup'])==8 and all(c['conclusion']=='SUCCESS' and c['status']=='COMPLETED' for c in pr['statusCheckRollup']), 'PR exact eight completed checks')
check({re.search(r'/runs/(\d+)/',c['detailsUrl']).group(1) for c in pr['statusCheckRollup']}=={'37958468683','37958473282'}, 'PR final C1b runs')
check(pr['body']==(ROOT/'tests/.work/T30-pr-body.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'), 'PR actual body exact reviewed text')

attr='docs/codex/evidence/.gitattributes'
adiff=git('diff','--cached','--',attr).decode()
added=[line[1:] for line in adiff.splitlines() if line.startswith('+') and not line.startswith('+++') and line[1:] and not line[1:].startswith('#')]
check(added==['T30-reports/review/coverage-review.md -text whitespace=blank-at-eol,-blank-at-eof,space-before-tab,cr-at-eol'], 'only exact coverage EOF exception',added)

private_strings={str(ROOT),str(ROOT).replace('\\','/'),os.environ.get('USERPROFILE',''),os.environ.get('USERNAME',''),os.environ.get('COMPUTERNAME','')}-{''}
secret=re.compile(r'-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----|\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}|\bgithub_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{40,}|\bAKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}\b')
privacy_hits=[]
for path in staged:
    data=(ROOT/path).read_bytes()
    try: text=data.decode('utf-8-sig')
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        check(False,'all staged payloads UTF-8 text',path); continue
    for value in private_strings:
        if re.search(r'(?<![\w])'+re.escape(value)+r'(?![\w])',text,re.I): privacy_hits.append({'path':path,'kind':'private local identity/path'})
    if secret.search(text): privacy_hits.append({'path':path,'kind':'secret pattern'})
check(not privacy_hits,'staged privacy/secret sanity',privacy_hits)
observations.update({'core_payloads':987,'core_payload_bytes':34624295,'manifest_sha256':EXPECTED_MANIFEST,'staged_path_count':len(staged),'case_counts':case_counts,'private_identity_or_secret_pattern_hits':len(privacy_hits),'public_core_regular_index_blobs':len(expected_inventory)})
report={'schema_version':1,'task':'T30','audit':'independent_C2_staged_records_inventory_index_bytes_source_equivalence_counts_and_privacy','base_HEAD':head,'observed_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'auditor_sha256':sha(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()),'checks':checks,'issues':issues,'result':'pass' if not issues else 'fail','observations':observations,'limitations':['Read-only staged review; no application/native tests rerun. Previously accepted original C1b and public audits retain their exact scopes.','C2 is staged and uncommitted at review; commit/push/live source equality and current C2 CI must be captured afterward in session.','No merge, release-source R, final asset, publication or independent published-download acceptance. AC058 remains excluded and unperformed.','Privacy and secret scan is a bounded heuristic; independent whole-public typed/raw projection audit supplies the stronger original/projection checks.']}
out=ROOT/'tests/.work/T30-C2-review.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'result':report['result'],'checks':checks,'issues':issues,'staged_paths':len(staged),'manifest_sha256':EXPECTED_MANIFEST,'xml':observations['xml_inventory'],'report':'tests/.work/T30-C2-review.json'},indent=2))
append_scope: This JSON wrapper is the sole additional post-review record; it preserves exact original UTF8 source/result including CRLF escapes, without changing any of the 1001 audited staged files. Not part of frozen public core. No future C2 SHA is recorded.
